brief:
US President Donald Trump said Sunday that he spoke with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu on Saturday. "Just had a very good talk with him," Trump said, according to Middle East Eye, without providing details of their conversation's content or duration.

The call came as tensions remain high in the Middle East, though Trump did not specify the topics discussed during the exchange with the Israeli leader.
dek: Trump says he had good talk with Netanyahu US President Donald Trump said on Sunday that he spoke with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. "Just had a very good talk with him," Trump said of the conversation, which took place on Saturday.
title: Trump says he held good talk with Netanyahu
